levels.name: Foundation
levels.exit_gate: Every topic in M1.1 and M1.2 at proficient or compressed; no competency C02/C03 below developing

levels.name: Practitioner
levels.exit_gate: M1.3 complete; M2.1 proficient; 10 Tier A or B cases studied with exercises passed

levels.name: Architect
levels.exit_gate: M1.4, M1.5, M2.2 proficient; first architecture review exercise passed; C06, C07, C09 at least developing

levels.name: Senior Architect
levels.exit_gate: M2.3, M2.4, M3.1 proficient across at least 5 industries; all competencies at least developing; C12, C13, C14 proficient

levels.name: Lead Architect
levels.exit_gate: M1.6, M3.2, M3.3 complete; capstone simulations passed; all competencies proficient; review of weakest competencies due via spaced revision

levels_note: Levels and gates are non-calendar. Thresholds are defaults recorded as configuration, not hard-coded.
